summary.text: Tom Smith is a Republican state representative from Kentucky House District 86 who has served since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Tom Smith took office in the Kentucky House on January 1, 2021, succeeding Jim Stewart III.

In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Banking and Insurance Committee, the Natural Resources and Energy Committee, and the Transportation Committee, and he is vice chair of the Licensing, Occupations, and Administrative Regulations Committee.
